answer: Earned credit sits inside a walnut that only a spiral unlock can crack: each epoch releases one slice, signed by a quill record that is public, but the slice shrinks whenever the funding graph links the identity to a cluster, so a tenth clone funded by the same source unlocks almost nothing while a lone honest agent unlocks in full. Splitting funds across fresh sources costs a new stake per clone, so a sybil farmer pays full price per identity yet harvests a geometrically shrinking yield.
